corridor.text:
You step into the corridor. The darkness swallows you almost immediately. You trail your hand along the cold wall to guide yourself.

After what feels like minutes, you reach a fork. A faint blue glow pulses from the left path. The right path carries the distant echo of dripping water.

choices.text: Turn back to the starting room

blue_glow.text:
You follow the blue glow and enter a vast underground chamber. Luminescent fungi cover the walls, painting everything in an eerie blue light.

In the center of the chamber sits a strange crystalline structure, pulsing gently. As you approach, you feel a warmth in your chest and hear whispers at the edge of your mind.

The crystal seems to be calling to you.

choices.text: Back away and take the water path

touch_crystal.text:
You reach out and touch the crystal. A surge of energy courses through you. Visions flash before your eyes — the facility being built, experiments, people in lab coats, something escaping containment.

When the visions fade, you realize you can sense the layout of the entire facility. Every door, every path, every exit is clear in your mind.

But you also sense something else. Something on Level 3. And it knows you're here now.

choices.text: Rush to the nearest exit — the water path
Descend to Level 3 to face whatever is down there

water_path.text:
You follow the sound of water. The tunnel opens into a natural cave where an underground stream flows steadily toward a crack of pale light in the distance.

The water is knee-deep and cold, but the light ahead is unmistakable — it's daylight. You wade forward, and the crack widens into an opening.

You emerge at the base of a cliff, squinting in the morning sun. You're free.

hidden_passage.text:
You close your eyes and listen. Beyond the blue hum and the dripping water, you catch something else — a faint draft of warm air, coming from a crack in the wall.

You feel along the rock and find a narrow gap, just wide enough to squeeze through. Beyond it is a forgotten maintenance tunnel, still lit by emergency strips on the floor.

The tunnel leads steadily upward. After ten minutes of walking, you push through a rusted door and find yourself on the surface — a moonlit clearing in a forest.

No alarms. No creatures. Just silence and freedom.
